deadline.value: The Graduate School's international fall deadline is June 1; the Biology page sets no separate program date.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional supplemental material for the Biology PhD.
gre_general.quote: Optional submission of supplemental documents, such as scholarly works, GRE test scores

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

toefl_min.value: Department rule for international applicants: TOEFL above 577 (paper), 233 (computer) or 90 (internet-based).
toefl_min.quote: submission of a TOEFL score above 577 (paper-based), 233 (computer-based), or 90 (internet-based)

supervisor.value: Applicants must contact a potential advisor before applying, and faculty must agree to review; a suitable advisor's availability is an admission criterion.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must contact a potential advisor before applying, and the faculty must agree to review

funding.value: The page describes a typical course load for assistantship or fellowship students but states no funding rule.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's in biological sciences or a related field; current M.S. students may transfer within their first year.
entry_route.quote: Completion of a bachelor’s degree in biological sciences or a related field

notes: The Microbiology Ph.D. page (isu.edu/biology/degree-programs/graduate-degrees/phd-microbiology/) gives the same advisor, TOEFL and GRE-optional rules, so this record covers both. Biology requires a cumulative GPA above 3.0 in the most recent degree. The coursecat catalog was not reachable (HTTP 502).
name: Ph.D. in Biology (and Ph.D. in Microbiology)
